research_question: Does the direct-PPO null result persist under a larger on-policy interaction budget and a bounded set of conventional PPO hyperparameters?

historical_anchor.interpretation: The historical result applies only to the tested implementation, budget, and settings.

budget_design.rationale: Geometric doubling from the exact matched-budget anchor estimates a learning curve without selecting an arbitrary large terminal budget.
budget_design.implementation: Each default seed is trained once to 4x and checkpointed at 1x, 2x, and 4x, so the three endpoints share one stochastic training prefix.

hyperparameter_design.method: one factor at a time at 2x budget; all settings reported

rationale.clip_ratio: OpenAI Spinning Up documents 0.1--0.3 as the usual PPO-Clip range and uses 0.2 by default.
rationale.learning_rate: 1e-4 and 1e-3 form an approximately logarithmic bracket around the historical and official 3e-4 setting.
rationale.entropy_coefficient: 0 and 0.01 bracket the historical 0.005 coefficient and test whether its sparse success is exploration-sensitive.
rationale.scope: This is a local sensitivity study, not an exhaustive hyperparameter optimisation claim.

development_selection.blocks: the six V16.30 PPO DEV blocks generated on 2026-08-30; disjoint from PPO TRAIN and final F0--F5
development_selection.note: Earlier engineering smoke touched three DEV cells for non-PPO methods; no PPO checkpoint has been evaluated on these blocks.
selection_rule: then maximum total completed dose bins

confirmation.configuration: the single DEV-selected profile and budget, all five seeds
sets: the frozen six-block F0--F5 matched weak-curvature suite
the frozen nine-block factor-separated main-method suite
confirmation.analysis: common-block hierarchical bootstrap with checkpoint seeds sampled independently across method families; point estimates and pointwise 95% intervals; no superiority gate

reporting_and_stopping.null_result_interpretation: A null result supports only bounded robustness of the present PPO comparison, not universal PPO failure.
reporting_and_stopping.positive_result_interpretation: A positive result replaces the weak PPO baseline in the paper and narrows any TD-MPC2 comparison accordingly.
